mapper.select: SELECT to_jsonb(u) ->> 'employee_no' AS employee_no, hp.person_key IS NOT NULL AS employee_linked, COALESCE(hp.name_ko, u.user_name) AS name_ko, hp.name_en AS name_en, hp.profile_photo_url AS profile_photo_url, d.dept_nm AS dept_name, grade.code_name AS grade_name, position.code_name AS position_name, employment.code_name AS employment_type_name, status.code_name AS service_status_name, hp.birth_date AS birth_date, hp.gender_code AS gender_code, hp.hire_date AS hire_date, hp.retire_date AS retire_date, hp.promotion_date AS promotion_date, u.email AS email, u.phone AS phone, u.postal_code AS postal_code, u.address_line1 AS address_line1, u.address_line2 AS address_line2 FROM users u LEFT JOIN hrm_person hp ON hp.employee_no = (to_jsonb(u) ->> 'employee_no') LEFT JOIN hrm_org_dept d ON hp.dept_cd = d.dept_cd AND d.use_yn = 'Y' LEFT JOIN com_code grade ON hp.grade_code = grade.code AND grade.parent_code = '102' AND grade.use_yn = 'Y' LEFT JOIN com_code position ON hp.position_code = position.code AND position.parent_code = '103' AND position.use_yn = 'Y' LEFT JOIN com_code employment ON hp.employment_type_code = employment.code AND employment.parent_code = '104' AND employment.use_yn = 'Y' LEFT JOIN com_code status ON hp.service_status_code = status.code AND status.parent_code = '101' AND status.use_yn = 'Y' WHERE u.user_id = #{userId} AND u.status != 'D'
SELECT hp.person_key FROM users u JOIN hrm_person hp ON hp.employee_no = (to_jsonb(u) ->> 'employee_no') WHERE u.user_id = #{userId} AND u.status != 'D'

SELECT a.assignment_key AS assignment_key, a.assignment_date AS assignment_date, a.assignment_end_date AS assignment_end_date, assignment_type.code_name AS assignment_type_name, d.dept_nm AS dept_name, grade.code_name AS grade_name, position.code_name AS position_name, job_title.code_name AS job_title_name, a.assignment_content AS assignment_content, a.concurrent_assignment_yn AS concurrent_assignment_yn, a.remark AS remark FROM hrm_assignment a LEFT JOIN com_code assignment_type ON a.assignment_type_code = assignment_type.code AND assignment_type.parent_code = '105' AND assignment_type.use_yn = 'Y' LEFT JOIN hrm_org_dept d ON a.dept_cd = d.dept_cd AND d.use_yn = 'Y' LEFT JOIN com_code grade ON a.grade_code = grade.code AND grade.parent_code = '102' AND grade.use_yn = 'Y' LEFT JOIN com_code position ON a.position_code = position.code AND position.parent_code = '103' AND position.use_yn = 'Y' LEFT JOIN com_code job_title ON a.job_title_code = job_title.code AND job_title.parent_code = '106' AND job_title.use_yn = 'Y' WHERE a.person_key = #{personKey} AND a.del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY a.assignment_date DESC, a.assignment_key

SELECT c.career_key AS career_key, c.company_name AS company_name, c.job_title AS job_title, c.job_responsibility AS job_responsibility, c.hire_date AS hire_date, c.retire_date AS retire_date, employment.code_name AS employment_type_name, c.remark AS remark FROM hrm_career c LEFT JOIN com_code employment ON c.employment_type_code = employment.code AND employment.parent_code = '104' AND employment.use_yn = 'Y' WHERE c.person_key = #{personKey} AND c.del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY c.hire_date DESC, c.career_key

SELECT e.education_key AS education_key, school_type.code_name AS school_type_name, e.school_name AS school_name, e.admission_date AS admission_date, e.graduation_date AS graduation_date, graduation_status.code_name AS graduation_status_name, degree.code_name AS degree_name, field.code_name AS field_name, e.major AS major, e.minor AS minor, e.is_final_education AS final_education, e.remark AS remark FROM hrm_education e LEFT JOIN com_code school_type ON e.school_type_code = school_type.code AND school_type.parent_code = '110' AND school_type.use_yn = 'Y' LEFT JOIN com_code graduation_status ON e.graduation_status_code = graduation_status.code AND graduation_status.parent_code = '120' AND graduation_status.use_yn = 'Y' LEFT JOIN com_code degree ON e.degree_code = degree.code AND degree.parent_code = '130' AND degree.use_yn = 'Y' LEFT JOIN com_code field ON e.field_code = field.code AND field.parent_code = '140' AND field.use_yn = 'Y' WHERE e.person_key = #{personKey} AND e.del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY e.is_final_education DESC, e.graduation_date DESC NULLS LAST, e.education_key
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET email = #{contact.email}, phone = #{contact.phone}, postal_code = #{contact.postalCode}, address_line1 = #{contact.addressLine1}, address_line2 = #{contact.addressLine2}, upt_dt = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status != 'D'
